question: Among customers who purchased product ID 5 at a price per unit greater than 20.00, which segment—SME, LAM, or KAM—had the highest percentage increase in gas consumption between 2012 and 2013? Only include customers whose transactions occurred at gas stations in the Czech Republic (Country = 'CZE').

WITH eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN products p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
    INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE p.XCL_008 = 5
      AND t.XCL_018 / t.XCL_017 > 20.00
      AND g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        ec.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM eligible_customers ec
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON ec.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    GROUP BY ec.XCL_002
)
SELECT 
    segment
FROM segment_consumption
WHERE cons_2012 > 0
ORDER BY (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2012 DESC
LIMIT 1
